name: SendTimestamps
description: Send timestamps easily via chat box button & text shortcuts. Read the extended description!
notes: Type a time in backticks, like `17:59` or `3:51 PM`, and it is sent as a timestamp everyone sees in their own time zone (the next occurrence of that time). The calendar button opens the timestamp picker. Upstream's picker also lists the newer "s"/"S" formats; Qord's picker offers the seven formats its renderer shows.
